title: AI-Fueled Demand Signals a Bigger Opportunity for Bloom Energy (BE) Investors
excerpt: According to Goldman Sachs projections, U.S. data center power demand could more than double from 31 gigawatts in 2025 to 66 gigawatts by 2027. BloombergNEF...
content_html:
According to Goldman Sachs projections, U.S. data center power demand could more than double from 31 gigawatts in 2025 to 66 gigawatts by 2027. BloombergNEF also estimates that data centers could account for 20% of U.S. electricity consumption by 2035. That would mark almost a four times increase in data center power consumption from current levels. ​AI workloads are driving the power demand.

However, utilities and gas-turbine companies are struggling to keep up with surging electricity demand. This situation is frustrating data center operators because of the extended wait to get a grid connection, which can take years. Faced with this situation, data center operators are turning to distributed power solutions, as these can be deployed more quickly. For instance, fuel-cell power systems can be up and running in a matter of weeks.

​Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) is one of the providers of fuel-cell power systems, and the company is benefiting from the growing demand for distributed power solutions. This translated to record revenue in the latest quarter and contributed to strong order backlog and margins improvements.

chungking/Shutterstock.com

Bloom Energy Translates AI-Driven Demand Into Solid Financial Performance

Bloom Energy's revenue more than doubled year-over-year to a record $1.07 billion in Q2 2026. That smashed the Street's estimate of $826.1 million. Adjusted EPS of $0.78 was nearly double the $0.41 that analysts expected.

On the back of the solid Q2 results, Bloom raised its full-year 2026 outlook again. It now projects revenue to come in the range of $3.9 billion to $4.2 billion. It anticipates adjusted EPS in the band of $2.55 to $2.85.

Notably, Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) has raised its annual sales outlook twice this year. It started with guidance of $3.1 billion to $3.3 billion in February. It raised it to $3.4 billion to $3.8 billion in April, and now raised it again the second time this year. This indicates management's growing confidence in demand.

The company's management has highlighted expanding demand from hyperscalers, neocloud providers, colocation data-center operators, and AI laboratories. Bloom has noted that its backlog is growing faster than revenue.

Compared to conventional gas turbine providers, Bloom has an edge in deployment speed. And this is helping it win over customers looking to avoid lengthy waits, such as its 2.8-gigawatt agreement with Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL).

​Despite its strengths, Bloom faces certain risks. The company's growth is tied to expanding data center capex. That means any slowdown in AI infrastructure spending could affect demand for its power solutions. Policy changes affecting clean-energy incentives and increasing competition could also weigh on the company's long-term growth.

content_html_zh:
据高盛预测，美国数据中心电力需求可能会增加一倍以上，从 2025 年的 31 吉瓦增至 2027 年的 66 吉瓦。 BloombergNEF 还估计，到 2035 年，数据中心可能占美国电力消耗的 20%。 这意味着数据中心的功耗将比当前水平增加近四倍。人工智能工作负载正在推动电力需求。

然而，公用事业和燃气轮机公司正在努力跟上不断增长的电力需求。 这种情况让数据中心运营商感到沮丧，因为获得电网连接的等待时间可能长达数年。 面对这种情况，数据中心运营商正在转向分布式电源解决方案，因为这些解决方案可以更快地部署。 例如，燃料电池电力系统可以在几周内启动并运行。

Bloom Energy Corporation（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BE）是燃料电池电力系统供应商之一，该公司受益于分布式电力解决方案不断增长的需求。 这转化为最近一个季度创纪录的收入，并有助于强劲的订单积压和利润率的提高。

重庆/Shutterstock.com

Bloom Energy 将人工智能驱动的需求转化为稳健的财务业绩

Bloom Energy 的收入在 2026 年第二季度同比增长了一倍多，达到创纪录的 10.7 亿美元。 这超出了华尔街预计的 8.261 亿美元。 调整后每股收益 0.78 美元，几乎是分析师预期的 0.41 美元的两倍。

在第二季度业绩稳健的背景下，Bloom 再次上调了 2026 年全年展望。 目前预计收入将在 39 亿美元至 42 亿美元之间。 预计调整后每股收益在 2.55 美元至 2.85 美元之间。

值得注意的是，布鲁姆能源公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BE）今年已两次上调年度销售预期。 2 月份的指导价为 31 亿至 33 亿美元。 4 月份，该公司将融资金额提高至 34 亿至 38 亿美元，今年又进行了第二次融资。 这表明管理层对需求的信心不断增强。

该公司管理层强调了超大规模企业、新云提供商、托管数据中心运营商和人工智能实验室不断增长的需求。 布鲁姆指出，其积压订单的增长速度快于收入的增长速度。

与传统燃气轮机提供商相比，Bloom 在部署速度方面具有优势。 这有助于它赢得那些希望避免长时间等待的客户，例如它与甲骨文公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ORCL）签订的 2.8 吉瓦协议。

尽管布鲁姆有其优势，但它也面临着一定的风险。 该公司的增长与不断扩大的数据中心资本支出息息相关。 这意味着人工智能基础设施支出的任何放缓都可能影响对其电力解决方案的需求。 影响清洁能源激励措施和日益激烈的竞争的政策变化也可能影响该公司的长期增长。
